fields.label: Site Code
fields.description: Permanent unique identifier for this franchise site. Used by the franchise's saathi_ecommerce app to tag every pushed record.

fields.label: Base Delivery Charge
fields.description: Flat charge added to every order from this franchise, before the per-km rate.

fields.label: Free Delivery Up To (km)
fields.description: Distance from the franchise within which no per-km charge applies. The base charge still applies.

fields.label: Franchise Site URL
fields.description: Informational only — the franchise's own ERPNext site address.

fields.label: ERPNext Site URL
fields.description: Full base URL used for API calls, e.g. http://saathimart.localhost. Required for order push to work.

fields.label: Company
fields.description: Exact Company name as it exists on the franchise's ERPNext site.

fields.label: Default Warehouse
fields.description: Warehouse used on pushed Sales Order items, e.g. Stores - SM.

fields.label: Delivery Charge Account
fields.description: Income account on the franchise's site that the delivery charge is booked against on each Sales Order (added as an Actual-type Sales Taxes and Charges row, not a stock item). Without this set, delivery_charges is still shown to the customer but never reaches the franchise's own books.

fields.label: Taxes and Charges Template (VAT)
fields.description: Exact Sales Taxes and Charges Template name on the franchise's own site, e.g. "Nepal Tax - SRPL". Must already have Included in Print Rate checked if this franchise's item prices are VAT-inclusive shelf prices (the normal case). Left blank means no VAT row is added -- only set this once the franchise's own template is confirmed correct, since this feeds their CBMS/IRD reporting directly.

fields.label: ERPNext API Credentials
fields.description: Generate from a dedicated integration User on the franchise's site. That user's role should be limited to Customer, Address, Contact, Sales Order, Delivery Note, Sales Invoice, Payment Entry.

fields.label: Reserve Stock on Sales Order
fields.description: Only turn this on after enabling Stock Settings > Enable Stock Reservation on this franchise's own ERPNext site. If turned on here while off on their site, every pushed Sales Order will fail to submit.
